Done. Committed `29f008769`. Here's what was built:

**`velocity.js`** — reads `events.jsonl` for `task-completed` events and computes:
- Total completions, 7-day and 30-day rolling averages (tasks/day)
- Daily completion chart (last 14 days)
- Per-plan: tasks done vs remaining, velocity, estimated completion date
- Trend detection: accelerating vs decelerating (first-half vs second-half velocity comparison)
- Supports `--plan <id>`, `--since <date>`, `--json` flags

**`/forecast` command** — runs velocity.js and presents results with interpretation guidance.

Current numbers: 111 tasks completed across 3 days, ~15.9/day over the last week. Most active plans are already completed so only `memory-system-design` shows in forecasts (with 0 tasks).
